short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 394 recent saved-signal files and 171 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @jusup11: 11.11 and Isometric NYC, plus 7 more. A source image from i0.wp.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from Mix: 35. Japanese Healing Music.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-25. Use fashion/material macro with shallow macro; make Split the plate into an assertive dark left pressure field and a warmer pale-fabric/skin-toned right field, echoing the Rolan cover without recreating the portrait. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against glossy black mask field with blue glyph edges, cream oval cutouts in black surface, and translucent mint fabric folds.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
